name: Ruthlessness
source:
You are an unfamiliar traveler arriving in a village. The villagers aren't happy about your visit, though.

Uncover the story of this little town and perhaps about yourself, too.

[From [url=https://rainch.itch.io/ruthlessness]itch.io[/url]]
